newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHARES BLOCKED AHEAD OF RIGA JEWELLERY MEETING.
newsitem.headline: SHARES BLOCKED AHEAD OF RIGA JEWELLERY MEETING.

text.p: Most shares in secondary list stock Riga Jewellery were blocked ahead of its shareholder meeting, the central depository said on Monday.
Of the 4.5 million shares in issue, some 3.6 million shares have been blocked, the depository said in a statement.

The largest shareholder is Riga Jewellery Factory with 60.08 percent of shares, followed by the state insurance welfare fund with 5.01 percent. Trasts komercbanka was third-largest shareholder at three percent.
